description: Land Acquisition - Gammeddegoda and Palliyapitiya, Rathgama D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, containing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations.
